description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractEntityConditionCache used for caching entity conditions in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages cache retrieval, insertion, removal, and cache invalidation hooks for entity conditions and related entities.

classes.name: AbstractEntityConditionCache
classes.description: An abstract cache class for entity conditions, providing methods for cache management, condition handling, and cache invalidation hooks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for a given entity, condition, and key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache for a specific entity, condition, and key, respecting the entity's caching policy.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries related to a specific entity or condition.

methods.name: getConditionKey
methods.description: Returns the condition itself or null if null.

methods.name: getFrozenConditionKey
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of the condition.

methods.name: getConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache map for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: getOrCreateConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the cache map for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if a map value is null or represents a null entity/value.

methods.name: getModelCheckValid
methods.description: Validates and retrieves the model entity for given old and new entities.

methods.name: storeHook
methods.description: Updates cache entries based on entity changes, with multiple overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an entity to a list of view value maps for a target entity.
